title: My Neighborhood
text:
My neighborhood is small and quiet. There is a park near my house. Many children play there after school. There is also a small shop on the corner.

The baker next to the shop makes good bread. Every morning, I buy bread for my family. My neighbors are friendly, and they always say hello.

questions.text: Why do children probably like the park?
options: Because it is a good place to play

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about the neighborhood?

vocabulary.definition: the area where people live, near their homes
the place where two streets meet
kind and pleasant to other people

paragraph_translations: Mahallem küçük ve sessizdir. Evimin yakınında bir park var. Okuldan sonra birçok çocuk orada oynar. Köşede de küçük bir dükkân var.
Dükkânın yanındaki fırıncı güzel ekmek yapar. Her sabah ailem için ekmek alırım. Komşularım arkadaş canlısıdır ve her zaman merhaba derler.
